video.title: AI欧腐《龙族Alpha的命定伴侣是单亲爸爸/The Dragon Alpha’s Fated Mate Is a Single Dad》
video.desc:
Betrayed, stripped of his scent gland, and left for dead, Omega dragon Rowan returns four years later as a servant in Dragon King Kieran’s estate—with their secret son. When Kieran recognizes his scent, their reunion sparks a reckoning with the family that destroyed Rowan.
Omega龙族Rowan曾遭人背叛，被剥夺气味腺后弃置等死。四年后，他带着两人秘密生下的儿子归来，却只能以仆人的身份进入龙王Kieran的庄园。
当Kieran再次认出Rowan的气息，两人的重逢也揭开了迟来的清算。那些曾经毁掉Rowan的人，终将为自己的所作所为付出代价。
